description: This file defines classes and interfaces for handling DWARF debugging information entries (DIEs) in a DWARF data parser. It includes base classes for DIE handlers, a root DIE handler, and a dispatcher that manages the processing of DIEs and their attributes.

classes.name: DIEHandler
classes.description: Base class for handling specific DWARF DIE types, providing virtual methods for processing attributes, handling children, and finalizing processing.

classes.name: RootDIEHandler
classes.description: Subclass of DIEHandler for handling the root DIE and compilation unit metadata, with additional methods for starting the compilation unit and root DIE.

classes.name: DIEDispatcher
classes.description: Class that dispatches DWARF DIE processing calls to appropriate handlers, managing a stack of handlers and coordinating the parsing process.

methods.name: ProcessAttributeUnsigned
methods.description: Handles unsigned attribute values of a DIE.

methods.name: ProcessAttributeSigned
methods.description: Handles signed attribute values of a DIE.

methods.name: ProcessAttributeReference
methods.description: Handles reference attribute values of a DIE.

methods.name: ProcessAttributeBuffer
methods.description: Handles buffer attribute values of a DIE.

methods.name: ProcessAttributeString
methods.description: Handles string attribute values of a DIE.

methods.name: ProcessAttributeSignature
methods.description: Handles signature attribute values of a DIE.

methods.name: EndDIE
methods.description: Marks the end of processing for a DIE.
